description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader committed to delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and driving continuous improvement in quality of care and operational efficiency. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the facility's culture and achieving its strategic goals.This full-time position offers a competitive salary, reflecting the critical importance of this leadership role. Join a team dedicated to making a significant impact on the lives of residents.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the State of Maryland.
Proven experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated leadership abilities with a strong focus on quality care and operational excellence.
Thorough understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.
